portrait.description: atlas portrait for the specialist card face (`spec-*`)

units.description: starting army as unit type ids — every card totals 500 supply

unitsLabel.description: the army, human-readable, for the card face

speciality.description: what this commander does — a behaviour the game code implements

unlock.description: the signature unit this commander can buy even if it is not in the starting army

shop.description: This commander's own shop — the unit types its side can ever buy or unlock, instead of the normal shop (e.g. The Komtur's forest roster, whose units are otherwise not buyable). Omit = the normal shop.

effects.description: what the commander does in a match — each effect is code, the numbers are the commander's

items.description: pack items granted into the player's inventory

tactics.description: Tactic charges this commander is gifted — NOT at pick time: they arrive at the start of a round, like the archer's free unit.

tacticsRound.description: which round tactics lands in (default SPECIALITY_TACTIC_ROUND)

forgeSpells.description: Stronghold forge spells this specialist unlocks (tactic ids). Teammates share the union. One 1-rune, one 2-rune, one 3-rune spell.

voice.description: Spoken VO casting + lines (authoring / future gen). Runtime still plays shipped cues; `externalIds` are for regen tools.

SpecialityId.description: A commander's identity (portrait art, telemetry, the hidden tutorial commanders). What a commander DOES is its `effects`.

flyingBonus.description: flying units: attack and HP × (1 + this) — Sky Sorcerer 0.12

unitStatsBonus.description: every non-structure unit: attack and HP × (1 + this) — Greedy Prince −0.12

incomePerRound.description: supply credited at the start of every round — Greedy Prince 100

roundOneSupply.description: extra supply at the start of round 1 — Elite Prince 100, Money Queen 200

recruitLevel.description: level new units are recruited at, permanently — Elite Prince 2

giftUnit.description: one free unit arriving in a round — Archer Commander: a level-3 archer in round 2

unitEachRound.description: one free unit of this type every round — Cursed Christine's Black Brood spider

speedBonus.description: flat movement bonus for every moving non-structure unit, after runes — Speedy Widow 3

unlockDiscount.description: shop unlocks costing at least `from` are `amount` cheaper — Countess Chonk 200 / 200

flankSpawnMult.description: multiplier on first-time flank spawn duration — Flanky Shadow 0.5

CommanderEffects.description: Commander effects; any combination works. Numbers here are what the card face text promises.

externalIds.description: Provider voice ids used by regen / casting tools.

lines.description: English (and future locale-overridable) line pools per event.

id.description: Provider voice id; omit until Voice Design has created one.

prompt.description: Voice-design prompt used to create this id; omit for stock library voices.

VoiceProviderType.description: Provider-agnostic spoken voice block (commanders now; units/spells later). English lines live here as regen defaults; locales may override via i18n.
